description: The Grassland Vegetation Inventory includes land-use polygons for industrial and residential developments as well as natural and agricultural cover in southern Alberta. Source descriptions identify a Sites table and up to four site types per landscape polygon, derived from interpreted aerial photography. Work began in 2006 and native coverage ends in May 2018. This record covers the explicitly developed-land component of the mixed inventory, without treating all vegetation as infrastructure. A ZIP is listed, but the internal geospatial encoding and asset-level resolution are unknown. Geographic coverage is Alberta.
